<a id="design-elevation"></a>
### Design Elevation

`design-skills:design-elevation` · skill · **core** · phases: Design, Polish & QA

Turns functional output into polished design: functional and perceptual patterns, interrogating every default.

**Use when**
- The dashboard works but looks 'fine' rather than premium

**Avoid when**
- Before a working version exists (function first)

**How to use**
- Dashboard structure: KPI bar -> primary chart -> supporting charts -> detail tables
- Question every default: font, radius, shadow, color

**Pairs with:** [Frontend Design](uiux.md#frontend-design) · [Data Visualization (Python)](dataviz.md#data-visualization)

**If not installed:** follow [docs/design/01-principles.md](../../docs/design/01-principles.md)

<a id="frontend-design"></a>
### Frontend Design

`frontend-design:frontend-design` · skill · **core** · phases: Direction, Design, Build

Distinctive, intentional visual design: subject-grounded palette and typography, no templated defaults.

**Use when**
- Any time you create or reshape UI
- The output risks looking like a generic AI SaaS template

**Avoid when**
- Pure backend work

**How to use**
- Ground choices in the client's world (their industry, materials, vocabulary)
- Avoid: single accented headline word, ALL-CAPS labels, decorative 01/02/03 numbering, entrance animation on every section

**Pairs with:** [Anti-Slop](polish.md#anti-slop) · [Design Elevation](uiux.md#design-elevation)

**If not installed:** follow [docs/design/01-principles.md](../../docs/design/01-principles.md)

<a id="interaction-design"></a>
### Interaction Design

`design-skills:interaction-design` · skill · **core** · phases: Design

Microinteractions, state machines, gestures, error prevention and product behavior across states.

**Use when**
- Designing drag-and-drop pipeline moves, quick-add, inline edit, undo

**Avoid when**
- Static content pages

**How to use**
- Specify every component's states: default, hover, focus, active, loading, empty, error, disabled

**Pairs with:** [Surfaces (inline / slide-over / page)](polish.md#surfaces) · [Motion](polish.md#motion)

**If not installed:** follow [docs/design/02-rulebook.md](../../docs/design/02-rulebook.md)

<a id="ux-writing"></a>
### UX Writing

`design-skills:ux-writing` · skill · **core** · phases: Design, Polish & QA

User-centered interface copy: buttons, labels, errors, notifications, onboarding, empty states.

**Use when**
- Writing every label, button and message in the CRM

**How to use**
- Verb-first buttons ('Add client', not 'Submit')
- Use the client's own vocabulary from the playbook

**Pairs with:** [UX Copy (quick)](uiux.md#ux-copy) · [Verbs (button labels)](polish.md#verbs) · [Errors](polish.md#errors)

**If not installed:** follow [docs/design/02-rulebook.md#copy](../../docs/design/02-rulebook.md#copy)
